story.title: Digi Yatra Builds AI-Powered E-Passport Enrolment System for International Travel Using Facial Verification
story.summary: The Digi Yatra Foundation has revealed new details of a proposed international travel system that combines e-passport enrolment, AI-powered facial verification, and token-based digital identity sharing at border checkpoints. The system aims to extend India's domestic airport biometric check-in infrastructure to cross-border travel, potentially affecting tens of millions of Indian passport holders. Privacy advocates have flagged concerns about data storage, biometric consent, and interoperability with foreign immigration systems.
